# ChessGPT feature extractor

`features.py` is the unchanged upstream Git blob from
[loocookie/ChessGPT](https://github.com/loocookie/ChessGPT), revision
`b7ea991854f926250036105f152894881e7820a2`, path `chessgpt/features.py`.
Its checksum and permission provenance are recorded in `PROVENANCE.json`.

Mohit explicitly confirmed on 2026-10-30 in this development conversation that
he has the author's permission to reuse and modify the source in ChessGuru.
The upstream repository declares no open-source licence. This notice records
the supplied permission; it does not grant a broader licence to other parties.

Only feature extraction is incorporated. ChessGuru owns search, typed scores,
legal replay, evidence verification, teaching admission and narration.
Upstream feature labels and numerical values are untrusted candidate evidence.
